Non reentrant for the same PduId. TxPduId Identifier of the PDU to be transmitted Parameters (in) PduInfoPtr Length of and pointer to the PDU data and pointer to MetaData. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK: Transmit request has been accepted. E_NOT_OK: Transmit request has not been accepted. Description Requests transmission of a PDU. Available via CanIf.h
